title: Personalised Hyperlipidaemia Therapies Guided by Pharmacogenomics

sections.abstract: This trial aims to evaluate the impact of clinical pharmacists' pharmacogenomics-guided choice and statin titration for managing hyperlipidaemia. The central hypotheses of this trial are (1) clinical pharmacists' pharmacogenomics-guided choice and titration of statins will lead to a more significant reduction in LDL-c; (2) lower incidence of myopathies with the use of statins for hyperlipidaemia management over 12 months compared to usual care by doctors alone. Active follow-up and titration should occur over the first six months. However, the participants will be followed up to 12 months to confirm the sustained LDL level attainment.
